sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Slurm GRES：GPU、CPU 與記憶體的整數裝箱
related.titleEn: Slurm GRES: integer packing of GPUs, CPUs and memory
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：任務成功、輸出有效、聚合完成各有獨立驗收。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Task success, valid output and aggregation completion have separate checks.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Slurm GRES：GPU、CPU 與記憶體的整數裝箱」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付資源向量、每種限制商數與記憶體高水位證據。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Slurm GRES: integer packing of GPUs, CPUs and memory with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver resource vectors, quotient limits and memory high-water evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以八欄填滿一百二十張任務卡，每批標 30 min。
計算 CPU=8、GPU=4、記憶體=floor(3.2)=3，取最小。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Place 120 task cards in eight columns with 30 min per batch.
Calculate CPU limit 8, GPU limit 4 and memory floor(3.2)=3, then take the minimum.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: DMTCP 協調檢查點：程序群組與重啟清單
related.titleEn: DMTCP coordinated checkpoints: process groups and restart manifests
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：任務成功、輸出有效、聚合完成各有獨立驗收。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Task success, valid output and aggregation completion have separate checks.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「DMTCP 協調檢查點：程序群組與重啟清單」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付協調群組、映像manifest、外部資源與本地重啟比對計畫。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct DMTCP coordinated checkpoints: process groups and restart manifests with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver computation groups, image manifests, external resources and local restart comparison plans.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以八欄填滿一百二十張任務卡，每批標 30 min。
列四份2 GiB映像及共同checkpoint ID，計算共享寫入下界。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Place 120 task cards in eight columns with 30 min per batch.
List four 2 GiB images with a common checkpoint ID and compute the shared-bandwidth bound.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
